title: The Mirror Pair Discipline
summary: The school course in casting mirrors in pairs so that each throws the foe's strike at the other and the school's closing reign ends the fight.

title: Manual of the Twin Faces
summary: The school manual of wearing two faces and a borrowed identity until the foe cannot say whom he is fighting.

title: The Dual-Track Phantasm Canon
summary: The school canon of two tracks of phantasm that run side by side through the qi field and meet in a single great illusion.

title: The Crown of the Hundred Seemings
summary: The school's high course of a hundred seemings worn at once from the Core and brought together in a single crown of false worlds.

title: The Gale Oath of Seeming
summary: The school discipline of swearing each illusion to the wind and holding that oath through every blow until the school's closing seeming.

title: Reckoning of the Level Lie
summary: The school reckoning of a deception laid flat and even over the whole field so that no foe judges height or distance true.

title: The Gale-Sworn Phantasm Canon
summary: The school canon of phantasms sworn to the wind that rise as a tempest of false shapes from the oath of the Oath-Voices.

title: The Deepest Oath of Sight
summary: The school's deepest oath sworn to the sight of the whole field and loosed from the Core as a vow no eye can break.
